The '''Commerce Guild fleet patrol craft''' was a type of [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol craft]] modeled on the [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighter]] that was used by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. Alongside [[Commerce Guild corvette/Legends|Commerce Guild corvettes]], these patrol craft were employed by the [[Escarte Guard/Legends|Escarte Guard]] to defend the Commerce Guild's [[Escarte/Legends|Escarte]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />
